cgsv.title: Gradient-Driven Rewards to Guarantee Fairness in Collaborative Machine Learning
cgsv.locations: Sections 3.1, 3.3, 3.4 and the hyperparameter paragraph; released implementation aggregation and reputation updates
cgsv.startup_difference: The written zero initialization is degenerate with the weighted-reference formula; the released implementation starts with data-size weights and then uses reputation

rffl.title: A Reputation Mechanism Is All You Need: Collaborative Fairness and Adversarial Robustness in Federated Learning
rffl.locations: Algorithm 1 and Section 4.3; released implementation aggregation and reputation threshold
rffl.implementation_differences: The released code clips instead of fully normalizing updates, starts with data-size weights and zero histories, waits before removal, and uses active-set size in its threshold
